Message.Name: Securities Equities Changes Of Batch Data Message
Message.Description: Equities Changes of Batch data. Mid-day updates to issue-level batch reference fields.

Field.Name: Board ID
Field.Description: The Board ID refers to each Board in which an issue is traded under different trading schedules and rules. Individual issue can be traded on more than two Boards under each Board's schedule and with d.

Field.Name: ISIN Code
Field.Description: ISIN Code.

Field.Name: A designated number for an issue
Field.Description: A designated number for each issue on a daily basis - Market(Information Product) : KOSPI(Securities A, Securities C), KOSDAQ(Securities B), KONEX(Securities B), Derivatives(DRV A), Spot Gold(Commodit.

Field.Name: Disclosing Data_Type Code
Field.Description: A data type code indicating a Batch data change and imposing/lifting sanctions to/from member firm.

Field.Name: Base Price
Field.Description: A base price of a day. A base price to calculate a upper/lower price.

Field.Name: Upper Limit Price
Field.Description: A price adding up the price limit to the base price.

Field.Name: Lower Limit Price
Field.Description: A price subtracting the price limit from the base price.

Field.Name: Appraised Price
Field.Description: An appraised price is a base price of an Issue of which base price is settled with today's single price, and it determines an upper/lower limit price for its opening price.

Field.Name: Highest Order Price
Field.Description: An upper limit price of an issue of which base price is settled with today's single price.

Field.Name: Lowest Order Price
Field.Description: An lower limit price of an issue of which base price is settled with today's single price.

Field.Name: Type Code for an Issue of which base price is settled with a today's single price
Field.Description: When a company implements a right/bonus issue or an issue is suspended in the long-term, such issue will use an opening price as a base price instead of closing price. Y/N refers to yes/no to this dec.

Field.Name: Rights Type Code
Field.Description: Rights Type Code (spot) is the same as adjustment code (derivatives) 00: N/A 01: Ex-rights 02: Ex-dividends 03: Ex-distribution 04: Ex-rights and Ex-dividends 05: Interim(quarterly) ex-dividend 06: In.

Field.Name: Par Value Type Code
Field.Description: 00: N/A 01: Split at par value 02: Consolidation at par value 03: Stock split 04: Reverse stock split 99: Others.

Field.Name: Lot Sizes
Field.Description: A lot size is an unit of a quote for a financial issue traded on an exchange. The quotes should be submitted with integer multiples.

Field.Name: Number of Listed Shares
Field.Description: Number of listed shares.

Field.Name: Designation
Field.Description: Information whether it is a designated issue for administration, liquidation trade, feverish issue in the short-term and issue with super low liquidity.

Field.Name: Closing Price Trading in the Pre-opening Market
Field.Description: Y/N to a Closing Price Trading in the Pre-opening Market.

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF).
